temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan initially reassures Christian, but then admits he has been keeping something from him and says he is in some trouble without specifying what it is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him; he feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian's suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan admits he was hiding something because he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been concealing trouble from him, but the nature of that trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, and concerned after the admission.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To find out what Jonathan's trouble is and uncover the truth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it; Christian offers help, and Jonathan accepts support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something because he is in unspecified trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan's trouble is complicated, and he is willing to accept Christian's help even though he fears involving him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and needs support and resources; Christian can and should help him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan through the trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian asks whether the trouble is illegal; Jonathan says he cannot be sure, may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but says he did not do anything illegal himself. Christian decides to look into it discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs help; Christian now suspects the trouble may be related to criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — his suspicion is partially supported: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people, though Jonathan denies doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may have been drawn into criminal or wrong-people trouble but may not be guilty of illegal acts; discreet investigation is needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and make sure he is safe.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; he tells Jonathan that someone is trying to set him up and that he has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people but likely did not act illegally; the truth is still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the investigation reveals that Jonathan is not the culprit but is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is the victim of a frame-up; an unknown person is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Determined, protective, and concerned for Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name and gather evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he found out the real culprit is someone both of them know and trust; he plans to confront them and bring them to justice.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; Christian is gathering evidence to clear him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the culprit is identified as someone close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone they both know and trust is responsible for framing Jonathan; this betrayal must be answered.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
